details.biography:
Chantal Nong Vo is the Executive Vice President of Production at DC Studios.

Before ascending to this leadership role, she served as Vice President for Feature Development and Production at Warner Bros., where she contributed to films such as Crazy Rich Asians (2018), The Meg (2018), The Intern (2015), Godzilla (2014), and 300: Rise of an Empire (2014).

Earlier in her career, Chantal worked as Vice President of Development at Légende Films, a company recognised for producing La Vie en Rose (2007).

She is also credited as an executive producer on several major DC-related projects. Notably, she was an executive producer on Superman (2025) and The Batman (2022). She previously executive-produced DC Extended Universe projects like Wonder Woman 1984 (2020) and The Suicide Squad (2021).

Regarding her background, she earned a BA in Economics and International Studies from Yale University. She furthered her training by completing the Peter Stark Producing Program at USC’s School of Cinematic Arts.
details.name: Chantal Nong Vo
